description: 晋级 / 断板追踪: every stock that closed sealed at the limit on the previous trading day, and what it did on `trade_date` — grouped by yesterday's height (highest first). Each level: `count` / `promoted` (sealed again, `today_height` = height+1) / `broken` (touched but unsealed) / `failed` (never reached the limit) / `promotion_rate` / `avg_pct_change` (that cohort's premium today). `members[]` carry `canonical_code`, `name`, `prev_height`, `outcome`, `today_height`, `pct_change`. The core sentiment-cycle read (昨日 3 板今天几家晋级、几家炸、几家跌停) that `max_height` cannot give. Intraday the outcome is live and can still change before the close.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

include.description: active = 排除 ST / 退市（默认）; all = 全部

trade_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today / latest

name: limit_up_promotion
